description: A Mediterranean journey shows how geology influenced settlement, architecture, water, resources and the development of civilizations.

s01e01.description: Across Greece, Turkey and Jordan, Iain Stewart shows how fault lines can bring both catastrophe and opportunity by channeling volcanoes, hot springs and valuable mineral deposits to the surface.

s01e02.description: The geology of Egypt, Greece and Italy explains why different stones encouraged different architectural forms, from pyramids and temples to the arches and circles mastered by Roman builders.

s01e03.description: A Mediterranean journey traces humanity’s long struggle to control water, from ancient flood disasters to the engineering choices that helped civilizations flourish or collapse.

s01e04.description: Salt becomes the geological thread linking climate, food preservation, trade and ancient Egyptian practices as Stewart follows its role across the Mediterranean world.
